episodeTitle.en: Managing nerves, anxiety, and burnout | Jonny Miller (Nervous Systems Mastery)
episodeTitle.zh: 管理紧张、焦虑与职业倦怠 | 乔尼·米勒（Nervous Systems Mastery）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jonny Miller is the founder of ⁠Nervous System Mastery⁠, a course that has helped hundreds of founders and tech leaders cultivate calm, reduce nervousness, enhance resilience, and elevate their sense of aliveness. Having personally benefited from Jonny’s teachings, I’m especially excited to have him on the show. In this episode, we discuss: • How shifting your focus from the mind to the body can help ease nervousness
guestBioOfficial.zh: 乔尼·米勒（Jonny Miller）是Nervous System Mastery的创始人，这门课程已帮助数百位创始人和科技领袖培养冷静心态、减轻紧张情绪、增强韧性并提升生命活力感。亲身受益于乔尼的教导，我特别高兴能邀请他参与节目。在本期节目中，我们探讨了：• 将注意力从大脑转向身体如何帮助缓解紧张情绪

chapters.title: The bottom-up approach to nervousness and anxiety
The power of breath in changing states
The concept of state over story
Breathing exercises to calm you down
The “espresso” breath exercise to give you energy
Recognizing emotional debt and avoiding burnout
The competitive advantage of “feeling the feels”
Advice for people overwhelmed by stimuli
The NSDR (non-sleep deep rest) practice for emotional release

title.en: Managing nerves, anxiety, and burnout | Jonny Miller (Nervous Systems Mastery)
title.zh: 管理紧张、焦虑与职业倦怠 | 乔尼·米勒（Nervous Systems Mastery）

summary.en: Jonny shares his "feather, brick, dump truck" framework, which shows that burnout begins with subtle bodily signals that escalate into crises if ignored. He argues that learning to notice early feedback lets people course-correct long before a breakdown. The conversation offers concrete techniques for regulating the nervous system, reframing burnout prevention as a trainable, body-based skill.
summary.zh: 乔尼提出了"羽毛、砖头、自卸卡车"框架，说明职业倦怠往往从细微的身体信号开始，若被忽视便会升级为危机。他认为，学会捕捉早期的反馈，能让人在彻底崩溃前及时调整方向。本期还分享了许多调节神经系统的具体方法，把预防倦怠重新定义为一种可以通过训练获得的、基于身体的能力。
